# Element criteria: structure and navigation (C01 to C08, C39)

What to check for each kind of element, on top of the eight gates. Source: `frontend/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md` §8.4. Items without a cited source are design choices. Where this file and the guide differ, the guide wins; where the guide and `frontend/DESIGN.md` differ, the product contract wins. Other groups: [actions and input](./element-criteria-actions.md), [data and content](./element-criteria-data.md), [layers, state and work](./element-criteria-layers.md).

Columns: Place · Semantics and markup · Copy · Colour · Red flags (duplicate or risk signals).

| ID | Element | Place | Semantics | Copy | Colour | Red flags |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 | App shell, page frame | navigation and content split; one scroll owner | `header`, `nav`, `main`, `footer`; second `nav` has a unique name | product name only | neutral surface, no accent | same logo or menu again in the body; nested document and inner scroll |
| C02 | Header, page title | top of content, states target and scope | one `h1`; document `title` = h1 text plus site name | menu name equals page title | `text.primary` | same phrase in title, path, tab and card title three or more times; hero title barely larger than section titles on a conversion page; superlative or unproven hero claim |
| C03 | Primary navigation, sidebar | visible navigation first (left or top), same order on every screen | `nav` plus `a[href]`, `aria-current` | 1 to 2 nouns, equals page title | selected: accent plus weight or marker; rest neutral | icon-only without names, primary items behind an unlabelled toggle on desktop, same item repeated in the body |
| C04 | Breadcrumb | above the title, real hierarchy only | `nav` with name, current item `aria-current` | parent screen names as written | link colour, current item neutral | repeats tabs or navigation; shows history instead of hierarchy |
| C05 | Tabs, segments | directly above their panel, same level only | `tablist`, `tab`, `tabpanel` (`aria-controls` on the tab, `aria-labelledby` on the panel), arrow keys (§5.6) | short noun; count as a separate badge | selected: underline or fill at 3:1 | page navigation marked `role=tab`; tabs inside tabs; a tab not tied to its panel |
| C06 | Search, filter, sort | right above the list or table; shows result count, applied conditions, reset | `search` landmark; labelled field | names the scope | applied conditions as neutral chips | global and local search look alike but have different scope; searching a value that is visible (derived ones included) finds 0 results; empty state with count, chip and message that disagree |
| C07 | Command palette, shortcuts | auxiliary path; normal entry point stays | `kbd` notation; no key conflicts; a letter-only shortcut can be turned off, remapped or is focus-only (§5.6) | shortcut shown in menus and tooltips | n/a | a function reachable only by shortcut; a standard shortcut overridden |
| C08 | Card, bento module | independent units only; title, content, action | `article` or `section` with heading | title summarises content | surface one step different; no status colour | card in card; nested click areas; same information also in a table |
| C39 | Document: title, language, heading order, skip link | a skip link is the first Tab stop (design choice; WCAG 2.4.1 also accepts landmarks or headings); `title` differs per page and updates when the screen changes (WCAG 2.4.2) | `lang` on `html`; one `h1`, no heading level skipped; skip link targets `main` | `title` = h1 text plus site name | n/a | generic or repeated `title`; a `title` that stays when the screen changes; `h2` before the `h1`; skip link after a long banner; wrong or missing `lang` |
